npc/keeper.doing: standing by his table in the hall, a key on a hook at his belt

happening.subject: anchor/keeper
happening.text: The traveller comes across the yard into the keeper's hall at Varley Ford.

happening.subject: npc/keeper
happening.text: The keeper tells the traveller what his key opens, and hands it over.

objectives.hint: The keeper stands by his table in the hall, through the doorway off the yard. The keeper's key, a key on a hook at his belt, opens his store.
objectives.title: Speak to the keeper

answers.missing_item: Locked. The keeper's key opens it, held in your hand.
answers.not_yet: Locked. Its key is at the keeper's belt: speak to him first.

happening.subject: anchor/seam-store-door
happening.text: The traveller unlocks the keeper's store with his key.

objectives.hint: The store door is the one door in the hall, in its side wall. Hold the keeper's key and use the door.
objectives.title: Unlock the store door

answers.done: The lever is thrown, and the shed gate across the yard stands open.
answers.missing_item: The lever is padlocked to its bracket. The keeper's key fits the padlock.
answers.not_yet: The lever is padlocked to its bracket.

happening.subject: anchor/seam-shed-gate
happening.text: The traveller unlocks the lever in the store and throws it; across the yard the shed gate's bars go up.

objectives.hint: The lever is on the store's back wall. Hold the keeper's key.
objectives.title: Throw the lever in the store

happening.subject: anchor/node-shed
happening.text: The traveller walks into the punt shed.

objectives.hint: The shed gate across the yard is open. The punt is inside.
objectives.title: Go into the punt shed

on_complete.text: The punt is yours to take.

happening.subject: anchor/node-shed
happening.text: The traveller stands in the punt shed at Varley Ford.

answers.not_yet: This is the keeper's hearth. Speak to him before you rest here.

on_rest.text: The keeper's hearth takes the chill off.

obj/hear-the-keeper.text: The keeper hands you a key on a hook. You may rest at his hearth.

happening.subject: anchor/seam-store-door
happening.text: The store door is unlocked, and opens and shuts by hand from now on.

obj/unbar-the-store.text: The key turns. The store door is yours to open.

happening.subject: anchor/seam-shed-gate
happening.text: The shed gate's bars go up into the stone.

obj/work-the-lever.text: Across the yard, the shed gate's bars go up into the stone.
